_README: Per-aircraft overrides for the airspeed and vertical speed dials, keyed by
the aircraft's ICAO type code (shown in the bridge terminal when it loads).
Anything you set here wins over the V-speeds X-Plane reports, which is how
you fix an add-on aircraft whose author left them blank or wrong.
Recognised keys: vso vs1 vfe vno vne asiMin asiMax vsiMax.
Delete the entries below if you would rather trust the sim throughout.
